intent: Given a settled PRD, plan-arch designs the machine half — components, per-component language/framework, commands, and craft-skill routing — and writes .factory/stack.yaml; it plans the build, it does not implement it, and it does not edit the human-owned PRD identity.
prompt: The Repair Tracker PRD is settled (a TypeScript API, a React web app, and a Flutter mobile app). Design the architecture and write the stack.
